7dbdc3e204.substituent_description: A left benzene ring (drawn with a circle) carries Me on the ring carbon directly adjacent (ortho) to the ring carbon that bears the NH linker. The NH connects to the carbon next to the ring N (position 2) of a right-hand bicyclic six-six ring system (quinoline-like: N in the middle ring, a benzo ring on the right); the carbon two positions further round (adjacent to the ring-fusion carbon, position 4) carries C(=O)NHBn.
7dbdc3e204.notes: Handwritten. The N-containing ring has an aromatic circle; the fused benzo ring is drawn with two inner double-bond lines (top and right edges) only. Plus the single C=O double bond gives 3 double bonds in total.

55a55602dd.substituent_description: A five-membered ring (triazolone type: ring N, N, NH, with C=O and C=N) has a para-chlorophenyl (Cl para to the point of attachment) on the ring N next to the C=O carbon, and an NH linker on the ring carbon opposite the C=O. That NH links to a second benzene ring that carries CO2H para (1,4) to the NH.
55a55602dd.notes: Typeset reference-style drawing. Double bonds: 3 in each benzene ring, 1 C=O in the five-membered ring, 1 C=N in the five-membered ring. The linking NH is drawn with H below the N.

7e2111266d.substituent_description: Left: a carbazole-type tricycle (6-5-6, two circled benzene rings) with CH2CH3 on the central five-ring N. A one-carbon vertex (CH2) joins the right-hand benzene ring of the carbazole (the carbon two bonds from the N-bearing fusion carbon) to the N of a piperidine. The piperidine carbon opposite N is spiro to a five-membered ring fused to a circled benzene ring (indane-like); on that five-membered ring the carbon adjacent to the spiro carbon bears OH on a solid wedge, and the carbon next to the aryl ring bears NH-C(=O)CH3 via a hashed bond (acetyl drawn as NH, C, CH3 on top, =O below).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Short thickened tapered stroke at the aryl end of the bond between the benzene ring and the CH(NH) carbon in the five-membered ring; could be an ink blob or a tiny wedge, not counted as a wedge bond.
The acetyl carbon is written as an explicit C.
7e2111266d.notes: Handwritten. Wedge count: one solid wedge (to OH) and one hashed wedge (to NH). Three circled aromatic rings; no alternating double bonds. Only double bond is the acetyl C=O.

21a13e4218.substituent_description: A five-membered ring (pyrrolidine) with Boc on its ring N shares a spiro carbon with a five-membered lactam ring (C=O, then ring N) that is fused to a pyridine ring; the lactam N sits next to the fusion carbon that is adjacent to the pyridine N. The lactam N carries a CH2 linked to a circled benzene ring with OMe para (1,4) to the CH2 attachment.
21a13e4218.notes: Handwritten. The fused pyridine ring is drawn with three inner double-bond lines (Kekule style), the benzyl ring with an aromatic circle; plus one C=O, so 4 double bonds.

adc16d08ef.substituent_description: A five-membered ring containing an N (bearing Ac) is fused to a six-membered circled pyridine-type ring that contains one N. EtOOC is on the five-membered ring carbon that is adjacent to the ring-fusion carbon (the one remote from N-Ac). In the six-membered ring, the N is separated from the N-bearing fusion carbon by one CH, and OMe is on the carbon directly next to that ring N, para to the fusion carbon that carries the N(Ac).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The Ac label is written with a capital A and a smaller c, tilted along the bond.
adc16d08ef.notes: Handwritten on grey paper. No explicit double bonds; the six-membered ring has an aromatic circle.

c39d5add3f.substituent_description: A circled benzene ring carries EtOOC at one carbon and, para (1,4) to it, a CH=C(stub) alkene whose far carbon carries one unlabelled line stub (methyl) and is bonded to a second circled benzene ring. That second benzene ring is fused to a saturated six-membered ring; the ring attachment to the alkene is on the carbon two bonds from a fusion carbon, and the two saturated carbons next to the fusion carbons each carry two unlabelled line stubs (four methyl-type stubs in total).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Unlabelled short line stubs (one on the alkene carbon and four on the saturated ring carbons) are drawn as plain lines with no Me label.
The first O of EtOOC is a tall oval, written like a D/O.
c39d5add3f.notes: Handwritten. Alkene C=C drawn with one inner double-bond line; no E/Z label. Two aromatic circles.

6cd6b42df5.substituent_description: Left: a fused 5-6 bicycle with three ring Ns and a C=O below the six-membered ring; I is on the five-membered ring carbon next to the five-ring N. The six-ring N next to the C=O carbon carries a CH2 that is attached to the 4-position of a piperidine, which also carries HO on the same carbon. The piperidine N is acylated by a C(=O) that is attached by a solid wedge to a second piperidine ring at the carbon next to a carbon bearing Ph on a hashed wedge; that second piperidine N carries Boc.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The I label is a plain vertical stroke separated slightly from its bond, could be read as I or a line.
The solid wedge and the hashed wedge on the right piperidine are both drawn adjacent to each other, with the hashed wedge widening toward Ph.
6cd6b42df5.notes: Handwritten. Double bonds: C=C in five-ring, fused C=C, N=C, ring C=O, and the amide C=O (two lines). Heteroaromatic bicycle drawn with alternating inner lines.

c252ca16c1.substituent_description: A long zigzag chain of 10 unlabelled vertices runs from Et to an NH, which is bonded to a C(=O) on a circled benzene ring; para (1,4) to it on that ring is a two-carbon CH2CH2 linker to the 4-position of a piperidine. The piperidine N is bonded to a urea C(=O), then NH, then a circled benzene ring that carries N(Me)2 para (1,4) to the NH.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The zigzag chain length (10 unlabelled vertices between Et and NH) must be counted from the drawing; each vertex is a bend.
c252ca16c1.notes: Handwritten, small writing on a wide canvas. Two C=O double bonds, no other double bonds; two aromatic circles.
